name: zmodel_instance_add_cycle_texture
description: zModel_Instance::AddCycleTexture forwards a texture-directory entry to the current entry's material cycle descriptor.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted for this isolated zModel instance wrapper; tier S work is deferred to a coherent zModel source-cluster pass.
